prompt: Analyze NVDA for me — is it still worth buying at these levels after the recent AI spending concerns?

assertions.text: Report contains real-time price data (not from training data)
Includes probability-weighted scenario modeling (bull/base/bear with percentages summing to ~100%)
Provides a clear, decisive verdict (STRONG BUY/BUY/HOLD/WAIT/AVOID)
Includes specific entry zones and stop-loss levels
Analysis is specific and actionable, not generic commentary
